state:
Goal `core-sse-and-2-more`. `Core\Sse::current`, `Core\Sse::retry` and now `Core\Sse::receive` have all
their feature proofs on disk under `docs/examples/core/Sse/`, `tests/hostile/core/Sse/`,
`benches/members/core/Sse/` and a Rust `covers:` test in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs`. `nvs run
--events <file>` runs a program as the isolate `Core\Sse::upgrade` opens (`crates/nvs-cli/src/events.rs`
is the format), and a `<name>.nvse` beside a proof is handed over as `--events` by `bun nv proofs`
(`docs/examples/README.md` § *Values published to an event stream*). `Core\Sse::receive` now returns
`null` once the stream is closed, after anything already queued. `receive` and `retry` have fresh perf
records. `Core\Sse::send`, `Core\Sse\Message` and `Core\Storage` are what the goal still owes.

items.text: **`Core\Sse::send` proofs** — `rule:testing/feature-proofs`: examples, attack, bench and a Novis case; the member is `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:694` and its card `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:359`. `Core\Sse::stream()` in a plain run prints the events, so most need no `.nvse`.

**`Core\Sse\Message` class card, then `topic` and `value` proofs** — `rule:core-api/reference-card`: a `ClassDoc` above `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/sse.rs:450` and `Core\Sse\Message` struck from `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`; the examples run under a `.nvse` file.

backlog: `Core\Storage::get`, `delete` and `list` owe every proof and `Core\Storage` its class card — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/storage.rs:168`, a stage of its own after `Core\Sse\Message`.
`bun nv peek --locate a b` prints nothing but the misses when one name is not found, and exits 1 — `tools/nv/cmd/peek.ts`.
